heroTitle: Architecture, scenography, and **lighting** in service of creation

sections.title: Architecture, scenography, and lighting in service of creation
paragraphs: Humberto Resende is an architect and urban planner graduated from Centro Universitário Belas Artes de São Paulo, with **over 15 years** of experience across architecture, interiors, scenography, and lighting. Born in Dourados (MS) and based in São Paulo, he built a multidisciplinary path that unites **technique**, **aesthetic sensibility**, and **business vision**, from executive design to the management of large-scale works and events.

His work spans three complementary fronts: **architecture and interiors**, **scenography and event production**, and **creative consulting**, always guided by a close reading of trends and by solutions that balance form, function, and visual impact. Every project starts with careful listening to the surroundings — climate, landscape, and the particularities of the site — in search of creative solutions that dialogue with the environment where the work will be built.

sections.title: A solid foundation in architectural lighting
paragraphs: Humberto's career began with a deep immersion in the world of **lighting**, an area that would become one of the pillars of his technical repertoire. He worked at reference companies in the sector, such as **DL Iluminação** and the multinational **Havells-Sylvania do Brasil**, where he worked on developing and specifying lighting design projects.

This foundation was deepened at **Godoy Luminotecnia Arquitetos Associados**, where he signed lighting projects for large-scale commercial developments and public works, including interventions for the **São Paulo Metro**. His technical knowledge was reinforced by additional training with brands such as **OSRAM** and **Philips**, building a rare command of lighting systems, technologies, and applications — a distinctive strength that today shows directly in the **sensory quality** of his architectural projects.

sections.title: Independent architecture practice and project management
paragraphs: Starting in 2012, already in Cuiabá (MT), Humberto began working as an **independent architect**, developing projects for clients such as the communications agency **Televideo** and the concert venue **Musiva**, experiences that broadened his outlook on commercial architecture, high-traffic spaces, and environments built around user experience.

During this same period, he led the **business management** of his family's rural company, conducting audits, restructuring, and implementing a new production plan with outsourced management — an experience that strengthened his ability to **lead teams**, delegate responsibilities with clarity, and manage complex projects and deadlines, a skill he still carries into every project and production he signs today.

sections.title: Scenography: creation in service of narrative
paragraphs: Since 2014, Humberto has been part of **Casa Caucaia · Cenografia Inteligente**, in São Paulo, working as a creative scenography architect. In this role, he leads the creation, development, planning, and execution of scenographic projects for events and artistic interventions, combining an architect's technical rigor with the visual language demanded by brands, productions, and immersive experiences.

It is in this field that his path connects most clearly to **creative consulting**: constant trend monitoring, event production and management, promotional set design, and artistic interventions are part of his daily work, always with close oversight of construction and direct coordination of multidisciplinary teams, from creation to delivery.
